## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem and what users or contributors can do after this change. Link the relevant issue if there is one.

## Verification

List the relevant checks and their results. Explain anything not checked and any remaining limits. Documentation-only changes do not need new tests.

## Scope and provenance

- [ ] The change is focused, with documentation updated where needed.
- [ ] No credentials, private source, cookies or usage ledgers are included.
- [ ] Existing frozen evidence, source pins and archived media are preserved; any new evidence is separately identified.
- [ ] Reused code/assets and their licenses are credited where applicable.

If the change affects model calls, execution boundaries, acceptance contracts or public hosting, explain the associated behavior and limits.
